assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved monoclonal antibody therapeutics (tocilizumab and sarilumab) and multiple high-resolution crystal structures, several with ligands bound. While small-molecule chemical matter is essentially absent from ChEMBL (0 IC50 entries), the target is highly druggable at the biologics level with strong structural and literature support.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL — the target has been exclusively pursued via large biologics (mAbs), so small-molecule druggability remains undemonstrated
Best resolution (2.4Å) is at the boundary of 'high' structural confidence; no sub-2.5Å structures confirmed with multiple ligand series

AlphaFold pLDDT of 77.9 with only 67.5% of residues above 70 suggests moderate disorder in portions of the protein (likely flexible extracellular loops or intracellular regions), which may affect small-molecule pocket definition
No allosteric or orthosteric small-molecule binding pocket characterisation reported in the literature
Lack of co-crystal structures with small-molecule ligands limits structure-based drug design for non-biologic modalities
